# third_party/math_utils.py

Used only as the last step of `src/verifier.py`, to decide whether two answers are equal symbolically.

- **Copied from:** the Stanford CS329A (Fall 2025) Homework 1 starter code, `cs329_hw1/tasks/math_utils.py`. That code is released under the MIT License: Copyright (c) 2024 stanford-cs329a.
- **Its own header says:** largely borrowed from the Qwen2.5-Math evaluation code (https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen2.5-Math/tree/main/evaluation). That code in turn draws on the Hendrycks MATH release, microsoft/ProphetNet (CRITIC), openai/prm800k, microsoft/ToRA and deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-Math.

The upstream licence terms apply to this file. It is included unmodified.
